purpose: Black-box release regression for the Integration Sprint. It checks the integrated public surfaces without importing another Worker's implementation.

run_contract.note: This gate checks integrated product behavior and wording. It does not establish human time savings, usability, productivity, legal correctness beyond recorded states, or verification inheritance across services.
